# VRで最もリアルなゴルフスイング

**30分間無料でお試しください！**

High Precision Control（HPC©）が一打一打をミリ単位で捉えます。ボールの挙動をリアルに再現。アーケード要素はありません。

**The R&A**、**Me and My Golf**、**DP World Tour**の協力を得て開発されたGolf 5では、鮮やかなHD画質で再現された名門コースをプレイできます。トーナメントに参加し、G5コインを獲得して、International eGolf Federationのランキング上位を目指しましょう。

- ソロプレイ、AI対戦、オンラインプレイ
- 9ホール、18ホール、短時間で楽しめるFlash 3 Holes
- チーム戦：Scramble、Fourball
- スコア方式：Match Play、Stroke Play、Stableford
- 初心者から上級者まで対応。実際のハンディキャップを算出
- 複数のピンポジション
- サブスクリプション不要

- 無料コース4種：Dunes、Forest、Tropical、Colorado
- 登録時にもらえる無料のG5コインでSafariをアンロック
- プレミアムコース8種：Royal County Down、Hoylake、Royal Troon、Birkdale、Royal Portrush、Old Course St Andrews、Sunningdale、Valderrama。今後も追加予定。
- 全コースでDrone View、Dynamic Wind、Practice Anywhere™に対応

🎯 **その他の機能**

- 革新的な短時間プレイモードWiPp
- Driving Range
- Putting Green
- ミニゴルフ
- Xti© Pro Launch Managerによるプロレベルのショット分析
- 無料のCallaway製クラブセット2種と追加セット3種
- VRゴルフクラブ用アクセサリーにすぐ適用できるプリセット
- 多言語対応
- 3Dアバターとモバイルアプリ

**VRで最もリアルでエキサイティングなゴルフを体験しましょう。**

nodes.long_description:
# The most realistic golf swing in VR

 **Try it free for 30 minutes!**

✅ **Why Golf 5?**

High Precision Control (HPC©) captures every shot with millimeter precision. Realistic ball physics. No arcade.

Developed in collaboration with **The R&A**, **Me and My Golf** and the **DP World Tour**, Golf 5 lets you play iconic courses in stunning HD. Enter tournaments, earn G5 coins and climb the International eGolf Federation rankings.

🏌🏻 **Authentic Golf**

- Play solo, against AI or online
- 9 or 18 holes or quick Flash 3 Holes rounds
- Team play: Scramble and Fourball
- Scoring: Match Play, Stroke Play and Stableford
- All skill levels, with real handicap calculation
- No subscription required

⛳ **Courses**

- 4 free: Dunes, Forest, Tropical and Colorado
- Unlock Safari with free G5 coins from registration
- 8 premium: Royal County Down, Hoylake, Royal Troon, Birkdale, Royal Portrush, Old Course St Andrews, Sunningdale and Valderrama. More to come
- Multiple pin positions
- All courses: Drone View, Dynamic Wind and Practice Anywhere™

🎯 **Also Includes**

- WiPp, an innovative quick-play mode
- Driving Range
- Putting Green
- Minigolf
- Pro shot analysis with Xti© Pro Launch Manager
- 2 free Callaway sets + 3 additional sets
- Instant presets for VR golf club accessories
- Multilingual
- 3D avatars and mobile app

**Get ready for the most realistic and thrilling golf in VR.**

The most realistic golf swing in VR. HPC© captures every shot to the millimeter. Real physics, no arcade.

nodes.long_description:
Do you want to have real fun playing and learning golf at the same time? Welcome to Golf5 eclub, a truly immersive genuine golf experience, that includes:

* 18 hole "The Dunes" course, where you can practice or play tournaments
* A driving range with all the clubs
* An astounding and realistic putting Green with different levels of difficulty
* When you don´t have much time, a WIPP version (Wood, Iron, Pitch & Putt)
* And finally, a mini-golf for initiation to the game

All can be played online with your friends. Compete and talk with players around the world. Just enter the clubhouse and look for them. Incredibly realistic and multiplayer experiences. Different rewards as you improve your level and skills. Learn and have fun, while you improve your handicap with the International E-Golf Federation rules, participate in tournaments and become an egolf pro.
nodes.short_description: Golf 5 eClub is a new way to learn, play and practice Golf. You will belong to a virtual club where you can play 18 holes or practice like in a real club. You can also play or compete online. A new immersive way to learn and practice your favourite sport.
